title: prunus plena
intro: Prunus plena, commonly known as the double-flowered cherry, is a type of flowering plant in the rose family. This plant is known for its beautiful double flowers, which are a combination of two flowers fused together, giving them a more elaborate appearance. Prunus plena has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and vasodilatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Prunus plena include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
